meta.title: 出片像呼吸般简单，天气热的十秒内要拍完
meta.title_en: Shots as Easy as Breathing — Finish in Ten Seconds When It's Hot
meta.topic: 拍照姿势 · 十秒出片

scenes.context: 正面站姿：最简单也最难——全身放松不僵。天气热，要在十秒内拍完。语域：拍照教学，姿势讲解。
sentences: 正面站姿，最简单也最难。
The front stance: simplest and hardest.
It's hot — finish within ten seconds.
paraphrase: 正面站姿 → front stance / facing the camera
不僵 → not stiff / stay loose
scenes.speak: The front stance: simplest and hardest. Whole body relaxed, not stiff. It's hot — finish within ten seconds.

scenes.context: 动态转身：转的过程中拍，不要转完了再拍。动态过程比静态更自然。语域：拍照教学，动态技巧。
sentences: Don't wait until the turn is done.
until the turn is done（转完）
The in-between moment looks more natural.
paraphrase: 动态转身 → dynamic turn / turn while moving
过程中的瞬间 → in-between moment / mid-motion
scenes.speak: Turn and shoot mid-motion. Don't wait until the turn is done. The in-between moment looks more natural.

scenes.context: 侧身姿势：万能显瘦角度，展示身体侧面线条。拍照前先选好角度。语域：拍照教学，角度选择。
sentences: The side angle is universally slimming.
它展示身体的侧面线条。
It shows the side lines of the body.
Choose the angle first, then shoot.
paraphrase: 侧面线条 → side lines / profile
scenes.speak: The side angle is universally slimming. It shows the side lines of the body. Choose the angle first, then shoot.

scenes.context: 放松收尾：假装拍完了，最自然的那一瞬间。趁对方不注意按下快门。语域：拍照教学，抓拍收尾。
sentences: Wrap up: pretend it's already over.
the most natural moment（最自然的一瞬）
Snap the shutter when no one's ready.
when no one's ready（趁不注意）
paraphrase: 收尾 → wrap up / the closing
趁不注意 → when no one's ready / off guard
scenes.speak: Wrap up: pretend it's already over. That's the most natural moment. Snap the shutter when no one's ready.

practice: The side angle is universally slimming.
Snap the shutter when no one's ready.
pitfalls: 「不僵硬」用 not stiff / stay loose。
「边转边拍」用 shoot mid-motion，不是拍完再拍。
The side angle is universally slimming.
Snap the shutter when no one's ready.
「趁不注意」用 when no one's ready / off guard。
shifts: 说拍照片只会 take a photo
用 snap the shutter（按快门）、shoot mid-motion（动态拍）、off guard（趁不注意）
用 slimming（显瘦）、side lines（侧面线条）、natural moment（自然瞬间）
用 choose the angle first（先选角度）、pretend it's over（假装拍完）、within ten seconds（十秒内）
